why.permission: You do not have permission for this action.
why.priceLockExpired: The price hold has ended. Save a new revision and send it again.
why.makerChecker: You created or submitted this order, so someone else must approve it.
why.noLines: Add at least one line and save before sending.

confirm.title: Confirm sales order?
confirm.text: Confirming assigns a document number and reserves available stock.

poConfirm.title: Confirm purchase order?
poConfirm.text: Confirming assigns a document number and starts supplier delivery.

issue.title: Issue purchase quotation?
issue.text: Issuing assigns a number and locks the quotation. It cannot be changed afterwards.

createSalesOrderDirect.title: Create sales order directly?
createSalesOrderDirect.text: The sales order is created now with each item's default tax. You can change charges and tax while it is a draft.

createPurchaseOrderDirect.title: Create purchase order directly?
createPurchaseOrderDirect.text: The purchase order is created now with each item's default tax. You can change charges and tax while it is a draft.

deleteDraft.title: Delete draft?
deleteDraft.text: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.

reason.label: Reason
reason.labelHint: Choose a reason from the list managed in Trade settings.
reason.noteHint: Add details up to 500 characters. Required for some reasons.

text.reject: Choose why this quotation was rejected.
text.cancel: Choose why this document is being cancelled. This cannot be undone.
text.hold: Choose why this order is being put on hold.
text.releaseHold: Choose why the hold is being removed.
text.poReject: Choose why this purchase order is being rejected.
text.pqCancel: Choose why this purchase quotation is being cancelled. This cannot be undone.

approval.pending: Awaiting approval. One approval is needed from someone other than the creator or the submitter.
approval.approved: Approved. You can confirm the order.
approval.rejected: Rejected. Change the order and submit it again.
approval.readyNoApproval: No approval needed. You can confirm the order.

error.DELIVERY_PDF_FAILED: Could not generate the purchase order PDF for delivery.
error.DELIVERY_ATTACHMENT_TOO_LARGE: The purchase order PDF exceeds the email size limit.
error.DELIVERY_EMAIL_NOT_FOUND: The supplier has no email address.
error.DELIVERY_EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: Email delivery is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.DELIVERY_EMAIL_FAILED: The supplier email could not be delivered.
error.DELIVERY_SOURCE_STALE: The order changed before delivery completed. Retry from the updated order.
